x: Bedford second and Derek Burfitt gave Nankeville a good run in the half mile. In the two miles team race we had the first three home, with Jack Brown, Vern Blowfield and Len Marchant finishing in line.

Derek Burfitt had a hard tussle with Martin of Surrey in the mile to win in 4 mins. 27 secs. with Jack Brown third. In the field events, Charlie Melchoir was second in the Javelin and third in the Shot Putt.
Alan Sexton's 220 yards' time was an A.A.A. Junior record, as was Derek Burfitt's mile time. Have we any claimants for a junior 1 mile walk record ?
George Flanagan performed extremely well to win the individual title and thus follows in the footsteps of Harry Shields, Ted Stimpson and Derek Burfitt, all past winners of this race.

From the fall of the starting flag the race was dominated by our own Derek Burfitt. At the end of the first lap he was comfortably ahead by some 90 yards and the farther he went the greater the lead he gained.

Belgrave's share of athletics success during the year started with wins in both the Surrey and Middlesex Cross-Country team Championships, the Surrey win with only 16 points!, and an individual win by Derek Burfitt in the Middlesex Junior.
Sixty-six young men had entered, and just 45 minutes after the first of the five heats was started, the final was won by Belgravian Derek Burfitt.
Our performers in Middlesex under the name of Cadogan AC slipped to 4th team, only Derek Burfitt, 9th, and Vic Blowfield, 10th, making the county team.
Other promising junior talent was emerging with D.Williamson, Derek Burfitt and Roger Dunkley. Britain's 5,000/10,000m challenge, thwarted by the presence of Zatopek, showed quality in depth.
